questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: you just had to apply via ku mobility online then you had to check on your concordia account if the times for the classes lined up

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: they just sent an email on how to do it

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: the whole thing with having to have forhåndsgodkendelse is so annoying because you apply but you dont even know if youre allowed to take those courses or not so then if youre unlucky you have to reapply and its such a hassle, i got lucky tho and i had no problems

questions.answer: i think there was loads of stuff , but i cant say from experience

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: hiking, going to cafes, exploring the city, clubbing is alright here, piknik events, so many fun festivals and concerts

questions.answer: this, plus you can go on trips to boston, new york and toronto (i did all 3 and recommend highly )

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: easy as i speak french and english, i didnt have any major culture shocks

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: just talk to them in class. people often dont want to make the first move but its necessary for one person to start so just be that person. it works trust me

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: nothing much i mean canada is a western country its not that different

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: people were kind, and very open compared to some people in denmark

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: go on trips as much as you can, you are in north america for 4 months, make the most of the traveling

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: live near campus - downtown. it can be so cold and you dont want to be antisocial because you live far away

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: the friends, the trips and the memories. the university also taught me so much from a different perspective

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: having enough time to do all the things i wanted

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: go on exchange its the best i swear

questions.answer: Yes
